text: Day three without water. Your blood thickens.
Rewind. Hour one: you feel nothing.
But breathing alone drains your water.
One percent gone, and thirst finally kicks in.
Your kidneys shut down. Pee turns dark.
No saliva. No sweat. Your body stops cooling.
Stand up, and you black out.
Lose ten percent: confusion. Fifteen: organs fail.
Most people last about three days.
In 1979, Austrian police forgot a teenager in a cell.
Andreas Mihavecz licked condensation off the walls.
Eighteen days. Guinness still lists it as the record.
For almost everyone else, it ends by…
